svg.aria-label: Heule 3x3 Matrix Multiplication Challenge 1: R=23 SAT schemes with type-3 pairings

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Heule 3×3 Matrix Multiplication — Challenge 1 (R = 23 SAT Type-3 Pairings)
10 satisfiable 𝔽₂ Brent-equation instances with hardcoded type-3 monomial pairings and zero streamlining constraints (hard for complete CDCL)
1. 3×3 Tensor T₃,₃,₃ & 729 Brent Equations over 𝔽₂
Example paired product M₂₁ (MM-23-2-2-2-2-3): pins a₁₁b₁₁c₁₁ & a₃₃b₃₃c₃₃
Rank-23 Tensor Decomposition: T₃,₃,₃ = ∑ u⁽ℓ⁾ ⊗ v⁽ℓ⁾ ⊗ w⁽ℓ⁾ (ℓ = 1…23)
2. Hardcoded Type-3 Pairings Across 10 SAT Instances
23 rank-1 slots M₁…M₂₃ colored by pinned type-3 multiplicity: 1 single · 2 pair · 3 triple · 4 quad
621 A/B/C bits + 1,863 pair (a∧b) + 16,767 cube (p∧c) + 7,290 4-XOR chain aux
8,019 native XORs/file · α = 4.42 · ρ_crit = 1.82× · YalSAT solves 5 in mins; 1C CDCL >10 s
